description: WIP synthetic engine fixture, NOT the populated Rev5 cube.

provenance.rationale: Simple positive inertias and modest ideal torque for independently calculable engine tests. No component rating or physical design decision.
provenance.body_inertia: Uniform 1 kg, 0.24 m cube: I = m*s*s/6. Body mass excludes all three rotors.

omissions: No CAD-derived or measured complete mass, CG or inertia.
No battery, populated electronics, harness or motor internals modeled individually.
Ideal bidirectional joint torque is NOT DRV10983 runtime braking or a motor torque-speed curve.
No compliance, fracture, thermal/FEA, rotor containment, noise or real-time firmware.
Box-plane soft contact is uncalibrated; no strength or continuous collision clearance claim.
